description: Use this when the user wants to buy a SaaS, micro SaaS or side project, or asks which businesses are for sale. Lists products their makers put up for acquisition on uneed.best, newest listing first, with asking price and trailing twelve-month revenue and profit when the maker disclosed them. Optionally filter by category, maximum price or minimum revenue, and include recently sold ones for comparables. Use get_product on a slug for the full profile; buyers contact the seller from the product page on uneed.best.

category.description: Category slug or exact name (see list_categories)

include_sold.description: Also return recently sold products (price and listing date only, no financials) as comparables

max_price.description: Maximum asking price in US dollars

min_revenue.description: Minimum trailing-twelve-month revenue in US dollars (excludes listings with no disclosed revenue)

name: list_products_for_sale
title: Products for sale
